name: Dayshift at Freddys: Doki Location
source:
What happens when the orange-tinted, text-to-speech-fueled madness of Dayshift at Freddy’s crashes headfirst into the cute, poem-sharing world of the Doki Doki Literature Club? Absolute chaos, that's what.
In this crossover visual novel, you don't just manage a crappy pizzeria or write wholesome poems for cute anime girls. Instead, you are thrown into a fever dream where Dave Miller, Monika, and a bunch of cardboard cutouts collide. Will you actually find true romance, or will you just end up getting banned from the local establishment for strangling toddlers in the ball pit?
translation:
当《玩具熊的白日班》的橙色色调、文字转语音的疯狂闯入Doki Doki文学俱乐部可爱的诗歌分享世界时，会发生什么？绝对的混乱，就是这样。
在这部跨界视觉小说中，你不只是经营一家蹩脚的比萨店或为可爱的动漫女孩写有益健康的诗。相反，你会陷入一个狂热的梦境，其中戴夫·米勒、莫妮卡和一堆纸板相撞。你真的会找到真正的浪漫吗？还是会因为在球坑里勒死幼儿而被当地的机构禁止入内？
